items.quote: Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar
items.claim: Moses took anointing oil and blood from the altar

items.quote: sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him
items.claim: Moses sprinkled anointing oil and blood upon Aaron, his garments, his sons, and their garments
items.object: Aaron, his garments, his sons, his sons' garments

items.quote: sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him
items.claim: Moses sanctified Aaron, his garments, his sons, and their garments
items.object: Aaron, his garments, his sons, his sons' garments
